# metrics { #src.metrics }

`metrics`

Module: metrics.py

Performance metrics computation for bias-corrected precipitation products.

This module provides functions for computing pixel-level verification metrics
that compare a test precipitation dataset (e.g., bias-corrected IMERG) against
a reference dataset (e.g., CPC-UNI). Metrics are computed per grid cell over
a specified dekad (10-day period) across multiple years.

Metrics computed (31 total):
  - Continuous:  Relative Bias, Pearson Correlation, RMSE, MAE, NSE,
                 Std Dev (ref/test), Std Dev Ratio, KS-test (stat + p-value)
  - Categorical: POD, FAR, CSI, Frequency of Precipitation Days (ref/test),
                 Mean Wet-Day Precipitation (ref/test), Dry Spell Length (ref/test)
  - Percentiles: p25, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99 (ref and test)

Output is stored as CF-1.8 compliant NetCDF with dimensions (time, lat, lon)
where time has one entry per year (timeseries mode) or (lat, lon) for
single-dekad aggregated mode.

## References {.doc-section .doc-section-references}

- WMO (2008), Guide to Meteorological Instruments and Methods of Observation.
- Wilks, D.S. (2011), Statistical Methods in the Atmospheric Sciences, 3rd ed.
- Ebert, E. (2007), Methods for verifying satellite precipitation estimates.

### build_metric_combos { #src.metrics.build_metric_combos }

```python
metrics.build_metric_combos(month_str, dekad_str)
```

Build the list of 9 reference-vs-test combinations for metric computation.

Combinations: {CPC, IMERGL, IMERGF} x {LS, LSEQM, LSEQMDL}.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type         | Description                                  | Default    |
|-----------|--------------|----------------------------------------------|------------|
| month_str | [str](`str`) | Two-digit month string, e.g. '01'.           | _required_ |
| dekad_str | [str](`str`) | Dekad start-day string: '01', '11', or '21'. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                       |
|--------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | list of dict | Each dict has keys: ref_label, test_label, test_file, output_dir. |

### compute_dekad_metrics_timeseries { #src.metrics.compute_dekad_metrics_timeseries }

```python
metrics.compute_dekad_metrics_timeseries(ref_da, test_da, threshold=1.0)
```

Compute verification metrics per year for a single dekad.

For each year present in both ``ref_da`` and ``test_da``, the function
computes 31 pixel-level metrics across the ~10-day dekad window. The
result has one time entry per year.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                               | Description                                                                                      | Default    |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ref_da    | [xarray](`xarray`).[DataArray](`xarray.DataArray`) | Daily reference precipitation, already sliced to the target month/dekad. Dims: (time, lat, lon). | _required_ |
| test_da   | [xarray](`xarray`).[DataArray](`xarray.DataArray`) | Daily test precipitation for the same period. Dims: (time, lat, lon).                            | _required_ |
| threshold | [float](`float`)                                   | Wet-day threshold in mm/day. Default is 1.0.                                                     | `1.0`      |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                           | Description                                                                                     |
|--------|------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [xarray](`xarray`).[Dataset](`xarray.Dataset`) | Dataset with 31 metric variables, dims=(time, lat, lon) where time contains one entry per year. |

### compute_pixel_metrics { #src.metrics.compute_pixel_metrics }

```python
metrics.compute_pixel_metrics(ref_1d, test_1d, threshold=1.0)
```

Compute all 31 verification metrics for a single pixel time series.

This function is designed to be called via ``xr.apply_ufunc`` with
``vectorize=True``, operating on the time dimension of each grid cell.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                        | Description                                                                                                                     | Default    |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ref_1d    | [numpy](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | 1-D reference precipitation values (e.g., CPC) over the dekad window.                                                           | _required_ |
| test_1d   | [numpy](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | 1-D test precipitation values (e.g., bias-corrected IMERG) over the same dekad window. Must have the same length as ``ref_1d``. | _required_ |
| threshold | [float](`float`)                            | Wet-day threshold in mm/day for categorical metrics (POD, FAR, CSI, FPD, MDWP, DSL). Default is 1.0 mm/day.                     | `1.0`      |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                                                                           |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | tuple of float | Tuple of 31 metric values in the order defined by ``METRIC_NAMES``. Returns all-NaN tuple if insufficient valid data. |

### compute_single_dekad_metrics { #src.metrics.compute_single_dekad_metrics }

```python
metrics.compute_single_dekad_metrics(ref_da, test_da, threshold=1.0)
```

Compute aggregated verification metrics across all years for a single dekad.

Unlike ``compute_dekad_metrics_timeseries``, this function pools all
available time steps together and produces a single (lat, lon) result.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                               | Description                                                                                      | Default    |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ref_da    | [xarray](`xarray`).[DataArray](`xarray.DataArray`) | Daily reference precipitation, already sliced to the target month/dekad. Dims: (time, lat, lon). | _required_ |
| test_da   | [xarray](`xarray`).[DataArray](`xarray.DataArray`) | Daily test precipitation for the same period. Dims: (time, lat, lon).                            | _required_ |
| threshold | [float](`float`)                                   | Wet-day threshold in mm/day. Default is 1.0.                                                     | `1.0`      |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                           | Description                                        |
|--------|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [xarray](`xarray`).[Dataset](`xarray.Dataset`) | Dataset with 31 metric variables, dims=(lat, lon). |

### run_metrics_pipeline { #src.metrics.run_metrics_pipeline }

```python
metrics.run_metrics_pipeline(month, dekad, mode='timeseries')
```

Run the full metrics computation pipeline for one month/dekad.

Loads CPC, IMERGL, and IMERGF datasets once, then iterates over all
9 reference-vs-test combinations. For each combo, it:

1. Regrids CPC to the test grid (if reference is CPC).
2. Slices data to the target month/dekad window.
3. Applies the land-sea mask.
4. Computes 31 verification metrics.
5. Saves results to CF-1.8 NetCDF.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                                                | Default        |
|--------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| month  | [int](`int`) | Month number (1-12).                                                                                                       | _required_     |
| dekad  | [int](`int`) | Dekad number (1, 2, or 3).                                                                                                 | _required_     |
| mode   | [str](`str`) | 'timeseries' (default) - per-year metrics, dims=(time, lat, lon). 'single' - aggregated across all years, dims=(lat, lon). | `'timeseries'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type        | Description                                                        |
|--------|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | list of str | Paths to the saved NetCDF files (None entries for skipped combos). |

### unify_cpc_for_metrics { #src.metrics.unify_cpc_for_metrics }

```python
metrics.unify_cpc_for_metrics(cpc_ds, test_ds)
```

Regrid CPC (0.5 deg) to match a test dataset (0.1 deg) in time and space.

Steps:
1. Ensure strictly monotonic time on both datasets.
2. Select only overlapping time steps (inner join).
3. Nearest-neighbor interpolation of CPC to test lat/lon grid.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                           | Description                                           | Default    |
|---------|------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| cpc_ds  | [xarray](`xarray`).[Dataset](`xarray.Dataset`) | CPC-UNI dataset with 'time', 'lat', 'lon' dimensions. | _required_ |
| test_ds | [xarray](`xarray`).[Dataset](`xarray.Dataset`) | Test (corrected) dataset to align with.               | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                           | Description                                                                                                           |
|--------|------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [xarray](`xarray`).[Dataset](`xarray.Dataset`) | CPC dataset regridded to the test grid with matching time steps. Returns empty Dataset if no overlapping times found. |
